title: MZ Sprite s go beyond tiles

posts.author: Azelno
posts.body:
Yo, I'm making good progress on my RPG Maker MZ project, but one problem is bothering me.
As I found the sprites very small, I decided to zoom them in, so I multiplied their size by 2. The bad news is that their heads fit into the tiles behind them, such as walls, trees, and so on. Is there any way of preventing them from getting behind certain tiles? Or do I really need to make them smaller? A plugin perhaps? Thanks a lot!

posts.author: SGHarlekin
posts.body:
Yes, it's a common problem with larger sprites and you can use
https://forums.rpgmakerweb.com/inde...edmap-js-you-can-walk-around-the-tile.103416/
to get around it. (Works in MZ)

posts.author: Timeline_man
posts.body:
well, with the situation you're in, I think the
OcRam Star passability fix
should do it.

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
you could try to find a plugin to increase the grid size beyond what the engine offers.
I don't know if one exists for MZ, but for MV Shaz wrote a 'Change Tile Size' plugin that allowed for both smaller and larger grids, up to 144x144 pixel per tile (if I remember correctly)

posts.author: Azelno
posts.body: Thanks to everyone for your help. I managed to sort it out with a bit of tinkering. See you next time!
